description: Rows of a table or dataset, each with the rows it rests on and why: source (its values' rows), names (rows its text names by key, and those they name), lists (rows whose text names its key). Every value in full, each row once; what did not fit is listed.

depth.description: How far names are followed. Default 2.

max_chars.description: Characters per reply. Default and at most 24000.

rows.description: t:Items/I-4, t:Items/{I-4,I-7}, t:Items/#3:#9, d:by_owner/#2, a whole table or dataset.

name: xlsx_trace
